privacy.title: Privacy policies
privacy.subtitle: By using the UiTrade platform, you accept and agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.
privacy.description_01: Small is an application designed so that companies can manage their contacts efficiently. By registering and accessing the application, you confirm that you are an authorized representative of the business and that you have provided true and accurate information.
privacy.description_02: We respect your privacy and protect your personal data. Small will collect and store personal information, such as names, email addresses, telephone numbers and physical addresses of your contacts, for the sole purpose of helping you manage your business relationships. For more information on how we handle your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.
privacy.description_03: Small is designed to facilitate the management of business contacts safely and efficiently. You agree to use the application in a responsible and respectful manner, both with your contacts and with other users of the application. Any inappropriate or unauthorized behavior within the application may result in the suspension or deletion of your account.
privacy.description_04: The security of your account is of utmost importance. Please keep your login information secret and do not share your credentials with anyone else. If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, please notify our team immediately of support.
privacy.description_05: We strive to continually improve Small. This may include feature updates and changes to services. We will inform you of any significant changes to the platform.
privacy.description_06: If you have questions, comments, or need assistance, please feel free to contact our support team. We are here to help you every step of the way.
